_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Offer Desk are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

app.title: Offer Desk
app.description: A governed offer graph that makes promotion decisions and evidence visible.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Ranked offers, fired triggers, and the current Money Ledger posture.
dashboard.emptyGuidance: Create the first offer and trigger to populate the board.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Offers, variants, channels, revenue lines, and deliverables share one lifecycle.
offers.legalTransitions: Legal transitions are shown from the current status.
offers.refusalReason: The requested transition was refused by a catalog rule.
offers.refusalRemedy: Choose one of the legal transitions or revise the trigger.
offers.auditTrail: Every transition is recorded in the append-only audit trail.
offers.roleRequirement: Only an operator may activate an offer.
offers.membershipFinding: Dangling membership is reported as a finding.
offers.emptyGuidance: Create the first offer to begin the graph.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Unknown and stale facts remain unknown; they never become false.
triggers.parseErrorDetail: Use declared facts, comparisons, and boolean composition only.
triggers.factTrace: Every fact used is returned with its age.
triggers.missingFact: Missing facts are unknown, never false.
triggers.factRegistry: Facts have observed dates and staleness windows.
triggers.emptyGuidance: Declare a trigger and fact to begin evaluation.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Agents may propose promotion; only an operator may activate an offer.
proposals.evidence: Evidence and facts consulted are visible.
proposals.effect: The requested effect is previewed before action.

health.title: API Health
health.error: Unable to reach the API. Make sure the scenario is running through `vrooli scenario start`.
